elements.name: q1
elements.title: How far must text generally resize without loss?

elements.name: q2
elements.title: A label is clipped at 200 percent. Is the criterion satisfied?

elements.name: q3
elements.title: Do relative CSS units alone prove compliance?

explanations.q1: The criterion requires resizing up to 200 percent without loss of content or functionality.
explanations.q2: Clipping loses content even when the control remains operable.
explanations.q3: Test the resulting content and functionality.
